title: NG Exhaustion V4 Clean-Source Deep-Dive Gap Matrix
core_conclusion: Core V4 is not broadly blocked by missing market data. Most ancestry, temporal, price/path, signed-flow, dipole and aggregate-book state already exists or is causally derivable. Dominant blockers are causal clock semantics, provenance/coverage, missingness-safe representation, unresolved lifecycle, immutable prediction ledger identity, and sealed prediction-to-execution handoff.

items.action: Carry only causally known ancestors with lineage revision/hash.
Attach lawful known_by/available_at before live use.
Preserve anchor type and availability timestamp.
Use current lawful cutoff minus known predecessor anchor; never target-relative time.
Build immutable UNRESOLVED/RESOLVED/CENSORED state and right-censor unresolved cases.
Construct prospectively; never expose posthoc future-successor overlap labels.
Use displacement/range/MFE-so-far/MAE-so-far/path geometry only through current cutoff.
Freeze signing algorithm, transform revision, source watermark and available_at.
Bind builder/source revision and derive backward-only geometry.
Sign-runs, area, slope, curvature and crossings; persistence confirmation cannot be backdated.
Use MBP depth/imbalance/recovery with state-age and stale/missing masks.
Require provenance-complete MBO/order-event coverage; otherwise mark missing/use explicitly named aggregate proxy.
Prove a causal frozen detector-native stream or omit it; do not rename roll-20 as native intensity.
Build causal predecessor/live-state graph with no future target node or future existence hints.
Build time/price/flow/dipole/book ratios and distances using only known state and explicit masks.
Preserve separable channels and test flat/gated/late fusion as V4 ablations.
Distinguish OBSERVED, PAST_CARRY, STALE, MISSING, STRUCTURALLY_NOT_YET_KNOWN, NOT_APPLICABLE and true zero.
Persist actual live causal discovery time; canonical retrospective t0 cannot substitute.
Preserve ts_event, ts_recv/observed_at, feature_available_at, model_evaluated_at and decision_available_at.
Pin dataset/schema/series/roll/raw_symbol/instrument/definition per source interval; fail closed on NG.v.0 versus NG.n.0 ambiguity.
Bind every instance/channel to raw object/message ranges and content hashes.
Produce exact per-session MBP/MBO/L1 coverage manifest before claiming full book availability.
Persist deterministic hashed probability entries and append-only first-lock/no-lock records.
Execution consumes sealed signal_id/execution_handoff_id and may not re-predict, re-time, re-fuse or substitute view/head.
Treat additional independent history as valuable when it adds deep/rare cases.
Preserve as case evidence only until chronology expands; never collapse or drop.

historical_support.policy: Do not relabel discovery weeks as fresh OOT. Add only provenance-certified outside chronology under unchanged frozen detector/canonical rules.

launch_state.reason: Prelaunch causal/provenance/state/ledger/handoff gates must be mechanically closed and tested first.
